ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_CCD] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus AS 
(
     SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCD.CUST_MARITAL_ST AS MaritalStatusId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD
WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCD.CUST_MARITAL_ST AS MaritalStatusId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,MaritalStatusId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,MaritalStatusId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE PeriodEndDate ='9999-12-31' AND SourceCode = 'CCD'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
     ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
     ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE
          WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND	SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  
AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode  
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31';



-----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus
(
     CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
     SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
    ,SRC.MaritalStatusId AS MaritalStatusId
    ,NULL AS CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');



DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_CRM] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS AS (
SELECT 
	BCC.ORGKEY as CustomerID
	,TMDATE as PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' as PeriodEndDate
	,BCC.MARITAL_STATUS as MaritalStatusID
	,NULL as CustomerMaritalStatusNote
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
	,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC BCC
	WHERE  BCC.isLatest = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(varchar,CustomerID), 
		convert(char,MaritalStatusID))) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerID
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceCode
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(convert(varchar,CustomerID), 
		convert(char,MaritalStatusID))) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerID
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceCode
    FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' 
	AND (PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31')
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
		 ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
     	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
		,CASE
			 WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID 
AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND  DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
 AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
 AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31';


-----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS (
	[CustomerId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[MaritalStatusId]
	,[CustomerMaritalStatusNote]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT DISTINCT 
	SRC.CustomerId
    ,SRC.PeriodStartDate
	,SRC.PeriodEndDate
    ,SRC.MaritalStatusId
    ,SRC.CustomerMaritalStatusNote
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_SEC] AS
BEGIN
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CLTCODE ORDER BY DATE_OPEN) RN, * FROM (
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1 
) A
)
----------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
,TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus AS 
(
SELECT DISTINCT
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL OR BSC.LASTUPDATED = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' 
          THEN CASE WHEN  GDC.DATE_OPEN IS NULL OR BSC.LASTUPDATED = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'  THEN  '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'
                    ELSE GDC.DATE_OPEN END
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BSC.CIVILSTAT AS MaritalStatusId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCECODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE BSC.CLTTYPE = 'I'
AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1

)
SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(char,MaritalStatusId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus 
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(char,MaritalStatusId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE SOURCECODE = 'SEC'  and PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'
)
,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	   ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
     ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND	SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  
AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode  
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC';





-----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus
(
     CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
     SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,SRC.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
    ,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
    ,SRC.MaritalStatusId AS MaritalStatusId
    ,NULL AS CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SRC.SourceCode AS SourceCode
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

END
GO
